US Rushes Patriot Missiles to Saudi, Qatar Amid Iran Tensions

The United States is deploying Patriot missile systems to Saudi Arabia and Qatar to safeguard oil and gas facilities amid heightened tensions with Iran. This deployment comes as the US perceives a potential for Iranian retaliation, prompting a build-up of American troops and warships in the region.
